def step(state, action, p, meta):

# HYPOTHESIS: jacobian_inverse_ik
# MECHANISM: Action represents desired end-effector displacement; joint updates are computed via Inverse Kinematics (Jacobian inverse).
PARAMS = {"gain": 0.5, "link1": 0.12, "link2": 0.12, "off_x": 0.0, "off_y": 0.0}

def step(state, action, p, meta):
    import math
    s = state.copy()
    ax, ay = action[0], action[1]
    
    a1 = state["arm.x"]
    a2 = state["arm.y"]
    l1, l2 = p["link1"], p["link2"]
    
    # Compute Jacobian of FK
    s1 = math.sin(a1)
    c1 = math.cos(a1)
    s12 = math.sin(a1 + a2)
    c12 = math.cos(a1 + a2)
    
    # J = [[-l1*s1 - l2*s12, -l2*s12], [l1*c1 + l2*c12, l2*c12]]
    j00 = -l1 * s1 - l2 * s12
    j01 = -l2 * s12
    j10 = l1 * c1 + l2 * c12
    j11 = l2 * c12
    
    # Inverse Jacobian (approx) to map Cartesian action to Joint deltas
    det = j00 * j11 - j01 * j10
    if abs(det) < 1e-6:
        det = 1e-6 if det >= 0 else -1e-6
        
    inv_det = 1.0 / det
    # delta_arm = gain * J_inv * action
    dx = p["gain"] * inv_det * (j11 * ax - j01 * ay)
    dy = p["gain"] * inv_det * (-j10 * ax + j00 * ay)
    
    new_arm_x = a1 + dx
    new_arm_y = a2 + dy
    
    s["arm.x"] = new_arm_x
    s["arm.y"] = new_arm_y
    
    # Finger FK
    c1_n = math.cos(new_arm_x)
    s1_n = math.sin(new_arm_x)
    c2_n = math.cos(new_arm_x + new_arm_y)
    s2_n = math.sin(new_arm_x + new_arm_y)
    
    s["finger.x"] = l1 * c1_n + l2 * c2_n + p["off_x"]
    s["finger.y"] = l1 * s1_n + l2 * s2_n + p["off_y"]
    
    s["target.x"] = state["target.x"]
    s["target.y"] = state["target.y"]
    return s

PARAMS = {"kp": 0.8, "kd": 0.4, "action_scale": 0.3, "link1": 0.12, "link2": 0.12, "off_x": 0.0, "off_y": 0.0, "n_substeps": 5.0}

def step(state, action, p, meta):
    import math
    s = state.copy()
    ax, ay = action[0], action[1]
    
    # Target positions from action
    target_x = state["arm.x"] + p["action_scale"] * ax
    target_y = state["arm.y"] + p["action_scale"] * ay
    
    # Initialize state for substeps
    arm_x = state["arm.x"]
    arm_y = state["arm.y"]
    vel_x = 0.0
    vel_y = 0.0
    
    # Substep integration
    n_substeps = int(round(p["n_substeps"]))
    if n_substeps < 1:
        n_substeps = 1
    dt = 1.0 / n_substeps
    
    for _ in range(n_substeps):
        # PD control law
        acc_x = p["kp"] * (target_x - arm_x) - p["kd"] * vel_x
        acc_y = p["kp"] * (target_y - arm_y) - p["kd"] * vel_y
        
        # Integrate velocity and position
        vel_x += acc_x * dt
        vel_y += acc_y * dt
        arm_x += vel_x * dt
        arm_y += vel_y * dt
    
    s["arm.x"] = arm_x
    s["arm.y"] = arm_y
    
    # Finger computed via FK
    c1 = math.cos(arm_x)
    s1 = math.sin(arm_x)
    c2 = math.cos(arm_x + arm_y)
    s2 = math.sin(arm_x + arm_y)
    
    s["finger.x"] = p["link1"] * c1 + p["link2"] * c2 + p["off_x"]
    s["finger.y"] = p["link1"] * s1 + p["link2"] * s2 + p["off_y"]
    
    s["target.x"] = state["target.x"]
    s["target.y"] = state["target.y"]
    return s

    vy = p["vel_scale_y"] * ay - p["damping_y"] * state["arm.y"]
    
    # Integrate velocity to get new joint angles
    new_arm_x = state["arm.x"] + vx
    new_arm_y = state["arm.y"] + vy
    
    s["arm.x"] = new_arm_x
    s["arm.y"] = new_arm_y
    
    # Finger computed via FK
    c1 = math.cos(new_arm_x)
    s1 = math.sin(new_arm_x)
    c2 = math.cos(new_arm_x + new_arm_y)
    s2 = math.sin(new_arm_x + new_arm_y)
    
    s["finger.x"] = p["link1"] * c1 + p["link2"] * c2 + p["off_x"]
    s["finger.y"] = p["link1"] * s1 + p["link2"] * s2 + p["off_y"]
    
    s["target.x"] = state["target.x"]
    s["target.y"] = state["target.y"]
    return s
